tierReason: Issue #16 is one Feature from the MVP Epic; adds event and mute tables plus mute settings API

decisions.decision: Tier Feature with Sensitive Areas schema, data, public-api
decisions.why: One Epic Feature whose blockers are closed; adds event and mute tables and new endpoints.

decisions.decision: Activity feed, read state and bell dot are part of #16
decisions.why: The user asked to add the in-app feed on 2026-11-25 and approved the mockup with a dot instead of a count.

decisions.decision: Bell sits on the Home header, not the project list
decisions.why: Home is the first screen; the user approved it in the mockup.

decisions.decision: Recipient rows double as push queue, feed and read state; 1-min timer plus tick recovery
decisions.why: One source of truth; the tick alone would delay pushes up to 5 minutes.

decisions.decision: Prior Art: reuse PushSender and extract catchUp send/settle into push/deliver.ts; claim SQL written new
decisions.why: The send/settle part is generic; the reminder claim keys are not.

decisions.decision: Offline mark-read uses a small pending-read set, not sync/queue.ts
decisions.why: Mark-read is idempotent and the queue is built for entity changes; a past lesson warns against folding odd changes into it.
